# Tln — the modern expert-system language

> Tln modernizes Prolog expert systems (ISO/IEC 13211-1:1995) into a deterministic, testable,
> data-native rule platform. A native Go engine (lexer → parser → validator → planner → executor)
> evaluates readable rule blocks over a pluggable FactStore. Rules read like English; facts are
> loaded from external systems (not written in .tln). Built-in ML primitives, first-class MCP tool
> orchestration, and a .tln.test framework. In production it is the decision core of OpenTalon,
> the enterprise AI-orchestration ecosystem (Expert-in-the-Loop: the LLM handles intent, Tln
> handles knowledge and inference).

## Docs
- [Getting Started](https://tln-lang.org/docs/getting-started/): Hello World, the family-tree/ancestor classic, the mental model (facts vs rules, EITL), and the CLI (tln build/test/run/explain/repl).
- [Language Reference](https://tln-lang.org/docs/reference/): core blocks (define, rule, detect, recommend, combine), values, operators, selectors, templates, priorities.

## Prolog → Tln (side-by-side comparisons; ISO Prolog left, Tln right)
- [Insurance claims](https://tln-lang.org/comparisons/insurance-claims/): block/allow rules, cap detection, conflict resolution by priority.
- [Derived predicates & recursion](https://tln-lang.org/comparisons/reasoning-recursion/): derive/detect chains, and negation-through-recursion under well-founded semantics (where ISO Prolog's SLDNF loops).
- [Fleet maintenance](https://tln-lang.org/comparisons/fleet-maintenance/): define/detect service intervals, and a forecast Prolog can't express.

## Beyond Prolog
- [MCP tools & workflows](https://tln-lang.org/beyond-prolog/mcp-workflows/): transport-free core + ToolResolver plugin (tln-mcp); reactive on-change → workflow, scheduled collect, remediate. Prolog has no native tool I/O.
- [Built-in ML](https://tln-lang.org/beyond-prolog/ml/): 11 explainable primitives — predict (CART), classify (kNN), forecast (exp smoothing), cluster (DBSCAN), find similar (cosine), anomaly (z-score/Grubbs), learned thresholds, PPR.
- [Testing](https://tln-lang.org/beyond-prolog/testing/): the .tln.test framework — given / when / expect.

## Production
- [OpenTalon](https://tln-lang.org/opentalon/): the enterprise AI-orchestration system running on Tln; every IO edge is an isolated plugin (tln-mcp tools, tln-db storage, channels, guard-llm, weaviate).

## Source
- Language: https://github.com/opentalon/tln-language
- MCP tool plugin: https://github.com/opentalon/tln-mcp
- Fact store: https://github.com/opentalon/tln-db
